# routeros_mpls_ldp (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `afi` (Set of String) Address families for which this LDP instance distributes labels.
- `comment` (String)
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `distribute_for_default` (Boolean) Whether to advertise a label for the default route (0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0).
- `hop_limit` (Number) Maximum number of hops an LSP may traverse, used by the LDP loop detection.
- `loop_detect` (Boolean) Whether to enable the LDP loop detection (hop count and path vector).
- `lsr_id` (String) Label Switch Router ID of this LDP instance.
- `path_vector_limit` (Number) Maximum number of LSRs allowed in the path vector used by the LDP loop detection.
- `preferred_afi` (String) Address family preferred for the transport connection when both are available.
- `transport_addresses` (List of String) List of the IPv4/IPv6 addresses advertised as the LDP transport addresses of this instance. The order is significant, the first usable address of the preferred address family is used.
- `use_explicit_null` (Boolean) Whether to advertise the explicit null label instead of the implicit null label to the penultimate hop.
- `vrf` (String) The VRF table this resource operates on.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `inactive` (Boolean)
